chapter_mission: Jedi-institutional confrontation over Order neutrality — Corran Horn's Council wing presses; Luke holds. The Jedi Order's posture is the book's final institutional question before the Vectivus climax.
chapter_turn: Luke explicitly chooses to keep the Order out of the Corellian war — a decision the book presents as wisdom even as it recognizes the cost.

scene_plan.purpose: Jedi Council session — Corran Horn presses; Luke holds the neutrality line.
Luke alone post-session; the dark-enemy dream sharpens.

exit_vector: Luke alone in the Council chamber after dismissal, the dark-enemy dream sharpening in him.
notes: The Council session is the book's last pure institutional scene. After this everything converges on the asteroid.
